scope: Current Schematch class and source/recipe catalogs, standalone prerequisites and regression checks

matchers.correction: EmbdiMatcher requires a separately installed HTTP service; it is not a native Java EmbDI implementation.

limitations: This update did not download publisher datasets, repeat the historical 9931-scenario scan, train models or run accuracy benchmarks.
Optional package, cached model and external service availability is separate from named class coverage.
PRISMA, PDED, SiMa, SemStruct, ReMa and learned-combiner outputs are file inputs; these systems have no bundled live backend.
JMM-2 and the remaining research terms listed in docs/matchers.md have no bundled callable implementation.
Exact paper replication still requires frozen selections, input snapshots, design manifests, annotations and dependency profiles.
